narr: Weak low pressure systems embedded in a hot and humid airmass over the region contributed to several rounds of heavy rain-producing thunderstorm activity. Isolated locations in northeastern Pennsylvania received between 2 to 4 inches of rainfall and experienced flooding of streams, creeks and roadways.
ev: Flooding submerged a car on North Welles Street. The road was impassible.
lsr: UPDATED EVENT TYPE. Corrects previous flood report from Kingston. North Welles Street impassible, car was submerged under water.
